title: Reply
description: From Core (from is CORE). To an operator interface, once for every message the operator sends (after its hello): accepted, or refused with an explanation, such as a command kind the Asset does not list in admin.describe. reply_from and reply_to name the operator message's (from, seq). For a query or a plugin.call, Core sends the answer first and the reply last, so the reply marks the end of the answer. For a plugin.call, failed means the Plugin ran and broke; it carries an explanation. Refusals include a command to an Asset that is not connected (Core does not hold it). asset_id is set when that message concerned one Asset, and geofeature_id when it concerned one geo feature; for a geofeature.set that created one, geofeature_id is the ID Core picked. Accepted means Core passed it on; the Asset's reports (task status, report.settings) confirm the effect. To an Asset, accepted acknowledges its admin.describe, its connect report.settings, or a final task report (completed, failed or cancelled): reply_from and reply_to name that message's (from, seq); for a final report task_id names its Task, so the Asset matches both. The Asset resends the message until it gets this. A retried message gets the same reply again, unchanged.
